reviewed_clauses.verbatim_extracted_text:
6.1.2 Accelerated Review 
 
When a marketing authorization application is submitted for a product of 
major public health interest, the applicant may request an accelerated/fast 
track review as laid down in TFDA Regulation, then TFDA shall ensure that 
the marketing authorization decision is made within 200 days.  Priority 
Review using Reference Drug Regulatory Authority Assessment from 220 
working days to 180 working days
